title: Give longing to service, not performance
summary: Service and remembrance keep separation from hunting false comfort. Receive the nearness already holding you.
takeaway: Receive the nearness already holding you.
lifeApplication: When longing becomes loud, give it a discipline right away: seva, simran, or one quiet act before sleep. Let the ache stay with the Guru day and night.

source.shortMeaning: Service and remembrance keep separation from hunting false comfort.
source.lifeApplication: When longing swells, give it service before it turns into performance.

evidence.coreClaim: Service and remembrance keep separation from hunting false comfort.
evidence.turn: Carry this with you: stay in service and remembrance until separation begins healing.
